item.title: Challenges Configuring Hudson Emails
item.description:
My recent Stackoverflow question How to use Hudson “Parameterized Build” values in an email earned me the “tumbleweed” badge because it had almost no views (39 in a week), got no answers and no votes. Therefore I decided to offer 200 of my reputation points for a usable answer.

But despite the high bounty of 200 geek points, i doubt that anybody notices it: The question is buried back at fourth page, near the bottom of 193 other bounty questions.
